carrier.name: Ordered Path with ALE Join Valuation
carrier.pathWord: free noncommutative word in admitted transformation identities

canonicalKeys.assumption: normalized statement plus declared scope and version
canonicalKeys.loss: normalized lost distinction plus source and target signature hashes
canonicalKeys.evidence: URI plus content hash plus version plus authority scope
canonicalKeys.rule: stable transformation identity plus exact endpoint signature hashes

duplicatePolicy.sameCanonicalKey: one ledger token with multiplicity recorded separately for audit
duplicatePolicy.reason: set idempotence must not collapse materially different provenance

irreversibility.rule: once a loss token enters a path valuation it remains in every extension
irreversibility.repair: a later reconstruction creates a new object with new evidence and assumptions; it does not delete the earlier loss
irreversibility.ordering: the path word retains operation order even when two words have the same ALE valuation

rejection.rule: a failing transformation is excluded before path composition
rejection.receipt: the failed rule and every failed gate remain visible outside the admitted path algebra

authority.compositionRule: path composition cannot raise authority above the least-authorized input or the protocol ceiling

classification.valuationAlgebra: commutative idempotent monoid / finite join-semilattice when token universes are finite
classification.pathAlgebra: free category restricted by exact endpoint typing and validation gates
classification.valuationMap: monoid homomorphism from admitted path concatenation to ALE join
